summary: This is an 8-K filing by the Federal Home Loan Bank of New York reporting a dividend declaration for Q1 2026. The Board declared a 7.50% annualized dividend, payable on May 22, 2026. No price per share, premium, or other deal terms are involved as this is a routine dividend announcement. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. It is purely a standard operational update regarding a quarterly dividend to member financial institutions.
